Lots of good restaurants in Mui nè Red pho isn't one of them.
Jan 2026 • Family
We had lunch at Red Pho, the menu looks amazing but unfortunately the coffee, the food and the whole experience was dismal.
First I ordered a Latte and I asked for it extra hot, it arrived and was luke warm. So I thought ok I'll just get another one and I made sure the waitress understood this time using Google translate, the second one I got was also hardly warm.
The food came out and this was just total confusion. My son ordered squid curry with rice and got prawn curry (he doesn't eat prawns).
I asked for prawns Tom yum with rice and got a seafood hotpot with rice which was only warm and rice was cold.
I had some prawn rice paper rolls which weren't fresh.
After all this they bring me the Tom yum I had initially ordered, by this time I was full and couldn't eat it.
 They then want to charge me for more dishes than I ordered ,after going over and over things using translate I said ok put it in a take away container and I'll pay and take it later..
We then sat there for 25 minutes waiting for the bill and the takeaway before going inside and asking to pay which I did..no bill ready no takeaway to go and just left, my son had a nice juice.

Tongue can be swallowed!
Aug 2025 • Family
This place is amazing! Went in once, realized the other places in the vicinity were no match. You will be brought cool water from the entrance, the room has air conditioning. From food, we tried almost everything. The baby is hooked on shrimp cakes with mash. I haven't eaten mash like this since I was a kid! You'll want to come back for him) Have tried mash chicken with mushrooms yet. Tuna and salmon steaks are great! It's like sous-vide, but it tastes better! 
The pho bo is beautiful and unequivocally better than in neighbouring places. 
They took a lobster. Live, weighed, cooked. Head off. 
Seafood noodles and seafood soup puree are the same song. Very, very tender and delicious. 
The staff are sensitive, very calm nice girls. The toilet, by the way, is crystal clear, which is damn important. 
Take fried bananas for dessert. You can swallow your tongue! Prices are lower than most places. 
The owner has great respect! Good luck!
